name: Welcome to Azeroth
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
narrative.offerRewardText: Lok-tar, champion. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect an emissary from the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.You have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 3,295 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: Exploring the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions.
